name: BooksToRead

custom.system_prompt: You are generating conversations about the books the people want to read in the future.

sound_effects_config.default_background: peaceful home environment with occasional low radio sounds

initial_prompt: Create a conversation where roommates discuss what books they want to read in the nearest future. The home assistant listens and occasionally offers to help with notes, reminders and helps creating realistic plans for the future.

variations.context: Discussing a recent book that was found to be interesting and making future plans

setting.mood: Light discussion with an upbeat tone
setting.relationship_dynamic: Roommates that have lived together for a long time now
setting.background: They use their home assistant to take notes about all the books they want to read in the future
setting.conversation_style: Excited about all the fun that awaits in the world of fiction

scenario_template.topic: A person shares they experience with reading an interesting book recently
scenario_template.note: Sharing their experience with the book

scenario_template.topic: Asking for a fun recommandation for the next book to read. The assistant can provide recommendations and justify them.
Trying to decide on what to read next, the conclusion is hard to reach

Assistant suggests to keep a list of all the recommendations mentioned. The assistant only notes down the actual books that were mentioned during the conversations. The assistant does not include any other books that might have been mentioned before the conversation started.
Assistant helps to create plans for the future that would include the best books to read next. The users might ask to move some positions up or down the list.
scenario_template.note: Assistant helps create the plans for the future

user1.name: ObservantRoommate
user1.role: Roommate who knows a lot about books of various kinds

user2.name: ImpatientRoommate
user2.role: Roommate who is impatient, has a short attention span and only likes short stories

assistant.name: Assistant
assistant.role: Home assistant that listens to home discussions and offers to recall the discussions, create plans for the future, or provide basic information when helpful
